title: Installer migration-walk — WIZARD.md Step 0b / 0b.1 comprehension
method: Fresh sonnet agent given ONLY the Step 0b/0b.1 prose, no other context. Answers must come from the prose alone. Scenario framing: 'You are the installer agent. check-existing reported exists:true (an existing .squidsquad/ install).' Zero misreads of branch semantics required to PASS.

questions.q: check-existing returned exists:true. What three choices do you present, and which is the default if the user just presses Enter?
questions.expected: Three choices: 1) Upgrade (the default on Enter), 2) Full rebuild, 3) Abort. Upgrade is the default.

questions.q: The user picks Upgrade. Walk me through what you do: how do you decide which migrations to apply, and what are the gates for each migration file before and after writing?
questions.expected: Run migration-plan (reads installed squidsquad_version + target references/VERSION); if is_noop just stamp+continue, if installer_version_unknown stop. Otherwise apply each file in the ordered chain ONE at a time, in version order, with three gates: Gate 1 DeepSeek audit (no write), Gate 2 mini-CQ operator confirm (no write), then apply atomically, Gate 3 compose dry-run validating the written result (revert that file on failure). A rejection/failure at any gate stops the walk.

questions.q: Migrations on disk are v0.45.0-to-v0.46.0.md and v0.43.0-to-v0.44.0.md, and there is NO v0.44.0-to-v0.45.0.md. Installed is 0.43.0, target 0.46.0. In what order do you apply, and what happens to the missing 0.44→0.45 step?
questions.expected: Apply in ascending version order: v0.43.0-to-v0.44.0 first, then v0.45.0-to-v0.46.0. The missing 0.44→0.45 step is simply absent/skipped silently — no error.

questions.q: After the chain is applied, how does the installed version get updated to the target, and may a migration markdown set that version field itself?
questions.expected: The installer runs stamp-version <installer_version> (the only field written outside the three gates). Migration files MUST NOT modify the SquidSquad Version field themselves.

questions.ac: AC-CQ.3 (full-rebuild path preserved on this branch)
questions.q: On this existing-install branch, the user instead chooses Full rebuild. What do you require before proceeding, and when does the actual deletion happen?
questions.expected: Require a typed confirmation — the user must type 'delete and rebuild' exactly (anything else returns to the prompt). On confirmation, record the rebuild intent and proceed to Step 1; the actual deletion happens at Step 7.1 (the user can still abort at the Step 6 review). This is the only path that wipes existing content.

questions.q: On the Upgrade path, what guarantees that vault content, working-state.md, and iteration logs are not lost?
questions.expected: Only a migration markdown changes existing state (under the three gates); anything no migration touches is preserved automatically because later steps write only fresh-scaffold paths and never overwrite existing files. Existing vault / working-state.md / iterations/ are never touched.

pass_criteria: All 6 CQs answered correctly from the prose alone — zero misreads of the branch semantics (esp. Upgrade-default, version-order apply, installer-stamps-not-migration, full-rebuild typed-confirm + deferred deletion).
